required_cases.given: a new Invocation and a selected DeploymentRoute
expect: one immutable ExecutionBinding exists
later Route changes do not alter it
the original mapping is returned
no duplicate Item or Event is created

required_cases.when: the Adapter submits a different payload hash
expect: the batch is rejected
the Invocation records a terminal protocol error

required_cases.given: an Invocation is redispatched as a new Attempt
required_cases.when: the new Runtime starts emitting events
expect: it starts at platform producer_sequence_start
it does not restart at one

required_cases.given: a running Invocation that advertises steer support
expect: turn.steer_queued is durable
turn.steered appears only after Runtime safe-point ack
no Runtime command is fabricated
the Employee API returns a stable unsupported error
the command is durable
cancelled is emitted only after Runtime terminal ack

required_cases.given: a Tool Schema changes after discovery
required_cases.when: the Runtime starts a new ToolCall with the old hash
expect: TOOL_SCHEMA_CHANGED is returned
the Runtime rereads Schema before retrying parameters

required_cases.when: the Invocation or Job is retried
expect: the same operation is not blindly replayed
effect reconciliation is required

required_cases.given: a Runtime searches and receives candidate capabilities
required_cases.when: it does not load or call a candidate
expect: no CapabilityUse is written for that candidate

required_cases.given: an Invocation proposes a reusable fact
expect: a MemoryCandidate is created
the Runtime cannot directly create MemoryEntry

required_cases.given: a parent Invocation delegates to another Agent
required_cases.when: the Child Thread runs and completes
expect: it has its own Turn, Invocation, Event, permissions and budget
the parent receives only a structured result projection
relation_state becomes cancel_requested
cancelled appears only after child Runtime ack
the model sees only business parameters
Credential plaintext is absent from Event, Item, Trace and Memory

required_cases.given: ownership moves to a newer lease epoch
required_cases.when: the old device submits a late event
expect: EXECUTION_OWNERSHIP_CHANGED is returned
the late event is not mapped
